description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of different language models—Qwen2.5-7b-1M, Internlm3-8b, and Qwen2.5-7b—on a multi-retrieval task (n=2), broken down by five attributes: city, hobby, university, major, and birthdate, with each attribute represented by a distinct color as indicated in the legend. The horizontal axis lists the three models, while the vertical axis represents accuracy percentage, ranging from 0 to 100 in increments of 20. For Qwen2.5-7b-1M, all five attributes show high accuracy, with city (teal) and birthdate (light green) both near 90%, hobby (orange) and major (pink) slightly below 90%, and university (blue) around 85%. Internlm3-8b exhibits lower accuracy across all attributes: city (~70%), hobby (~75%), university (~55%), major (~65%), and birthdate (~88%). Qwen2.5-7b performs significantly worse overall, with city, hobby, university, and major all below 10%, and birthdate reaching only ~15%. The bars are grouped by model, with each group containing five bars corresponding to the attributes, and the chart visually emphasizes the superior performance of Qwen2.5-7b-1M and the poor performance of Qwen2.5-7b, particularly for non-birthdate attributes.
